name: HC21b Previously on ART
description: Counts unique patients who are active on ART, had already passed three months on ART before the reporting quarter, have active TB ruled out at their latest ART assessment, and are documented as never having started TPT or as eligible but not yet initiated, with no historical TPT start or completion record.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE
    (
        (a.encounter_date >= :startDate
         AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY))
        OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
    )
    AND a.encounter_date <= :endDate
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
        WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
          AND x.encounter_date > a.encounter_date
          AND x.encounter_date <= :endDate
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
        WHERE s.patient_id = a.patient_id
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
        WHERE r.patient_id = a.patient_id
          AND r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL
          AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 3 MONTH) < :startDate
    )
    AND a.tuberculosis_status = 'No signs or symptoms of TB'
    AND a.tpt_status IN (
        'Never',
        'Eligible not Initiated'
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card t
        WHERE t.patient_id = a.patient_id
          AND (
              t.tpt_start_date IS NOT NULL
              OR t.tpt_completion_date IS NOT NULL
          )
    );
